## Observed

Callers of `daily-release.yml@7687a35` (v2026.11.14) lose their daily release when any PR merges to main between the scheduled trigger and the end of `prepare`:

- [pm-review run 43707938636](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-review/actions/runs/43707938636): the 03:23Z schedule was created at 11:14Z and its `prepare` job ran at 15:27Z. It stopped with `Default branch advanced; retry at its current head.`, because #87 had merged in the meantime.
- pm-review is approved for release, and npm has not moved past its 2026-10-26 first publish (2026.10.12).

On 2026-11-15 and 11-16, GitHub fired the scheduled triggers 4–8 h late, and hosted `prepare` jobs queued for hours during the midday peak. Active repositories merge several PRs in that window, so a daily `prepare` that must see an unchanged main can fail every day.

`docs/reusable-release.md` (invariant 6) says that "a changed base permits a fresh preparation on the next daily run". That retry is 24 h away, and it fails the same way.

## Proposal

`prepare` is read-only (`contents: read`), so when main moves before preparation is accepted it can restart at the new head inside the same run:

- Bounded: for example 3 attempts. The run still fails closed with today's message when main keeps moving.
- Same-day cap unchanged: the GitHub Release date check and the no `-N` rule stay as they are.
- `request` keeps its lease check: a move after preparation still refuses the branch write, so the invariant about mutating only a verified base is untouched.
- The summary logs each restart (old head → new head), so the hourly reconcile and operators can see it.

Alternatively, or in addition, the hourly `reconcile-only` run could admit one fresh preparation when today's scheduled preparation failed only on base movement and no candidate exists yet. That keeps one auto-release per day.

## Acceptance

- A merge to main during `prepare` no longer costs the day's release. A test drives a moved base on the first attempt and an unchanged base on the second.
- The refusal path is unchanged when main moves on every attempt.
- The docs replace "next daily run" with the new behaviour.
